L0: # Prices
L1: 
L2: Read this page in your terminal: [install the Stripe CLI](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/install) (v1.43.3+) and run `stripe docs`. [Reference](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/docs)
L3: ## Start here: Integrate with Stripe using skills and plugins
L4: 
L5: Stripe provides skills and plugins for agents to build faster and more accurately. See [Agent skills](https://docs.stripe.com/skills.md) for more information.
L6: 
L7: **Quickstart**: Install the Stripe CLI with `npm install -g @stripe/cli` and run `stripe agent setup`.
L8: > Nested parameters, fields, and event types on API reference pages are collapsed by default. Use the provided `?query=<name>` links to show the full definitions. Request the page with an empty `?query=` to expand every entry at once.
L9: ## Endpoints
L10: 
L11: ### Create a price
L12: 
L13: - [POST /v1/prices](https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices/create.md)
L14: 
L15: ### Update a price
L16: 
L17: - [POST /v1/prices/:id](https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices/update.md)
L18: 
L19: ### Retrieve a price
L20: 
L21: - [GET /v1/prices/:id](https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices/retrieve.md)
L22: 
L23: ### List all prices
L24: 
L25: - [GET /v1/prices](https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices/list.md)
L26: 
L27: ### Search prices
L28: 
L29: - [GET /v1/prices/search](https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices/search.md)
L30: ## Events
L31: 
L32: - `price.created`
L33: Occurs whenever a price is created.
L34: 
L35: - `price.deleted`
L36: Occurs whenever a price is deleted.
L37: 
L38: - `price.updated`
L39: Occurs whenever a price is updated.
L40: Prices define the unit cost, currency, and (optional) billing cycle for both recurring and one-time purchases of products. [Products](https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices.md#products) help you track inventory or provisioning, and prices help you track payment terms. Different physical goods or levels of service should be represented by products, and pricing options should be represented by prices. This approach lets you change prices without having to change your provisioning scheme.
L41: For example, you might have a single “gold” product that has prices for $10/month, $100/year, and €9 once.
L42: 
L43: Related guides: [Set up a subscription](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/set-up-subscription.md), [create an invoice](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/invoices/create.md), and more about [products and prices](https://docs.stripe.com/products-prices/overview.md).
